featured_reviews.name: Tulsi Tanna
featured_reviews.review_text:
This tiny, easy-to-miss outlet, right on Andheri SV Road is a great option for Dessert Lovers. For some of you, this name may sound familiar as it is a popular ice-cream brand from Surat. It has opened its doors to Mumbai & is now present in Andheri, Mira Road and Mulund.

DESSERTS

🍫 KitKat Sundae🍨
How does - 3 scoops of KitKat icecream loaded with generous fresh cream, topped with rainbow sprinkles - sound to you?
To me, it's sounds like Mission Impossible 😛
However hard I tried, I couldn't manage to even finish one scoop by myself. Go along with a bunch of foodie friends to finish this mighty bowl of dessert!
#MightyDessert #sinful

🥤 CREAMY MILKSHAKES
All the shakes are freshly prepared. Milk and cream is specifically procured from Surat and hence giving the same experience as the home-branch (Surat).

❤️ Afghani Dryfruits Shake
This shake is overloaded with goodness of nuts, saffron and cream. Every sip is filled with crushed dryfruits. This royal shake is a MUST HAVE!
#MustHave #SFFWrecommends

🍈Sitaphal Shake
Frozen pulp of Custard Apple blended with milk and cream ease the Custard Apple cravings even in off-season. This shake is so thick, it give the feel of having Sitaphal cream rather than shake. You may have to eat it rather than slurp 😋

🥃 FRUIT SHOTS
Looking at the vibrant colors and citric flavours of the fruit shots, confused me completely. 🙈
What did I do? Tried them all 😂

🍓 Strawberry Shot
I liked this one the best as it is one of my favorite fruits 💕
#MustHave

🟣Jamun Shot
Jamun also known as Indian Blackberry is very popular when it comes to fruit shots. Not my preferred fruit but I didn't mind having it the the form of shots.

🥝 Kiwi Shots
Pulpy kiwi shots will please those who love the tangy flavour

🍐Guava Shots
Who doesn't love Pink Guava? They have also added the chilly powder to the shot, giving it a perfect mix of sweet, tangy and spicy.

🍇 Mulberry Shots
I haven't tried Mulberry before but I loved these shots. Must Have for all the experimental foodies & berry lovers 😋

🌰 NUTSHELL REVIEW
Popular for its Kulfis, Sundaes, Icecream & Shakes, it's a perfect spot for satiating your sweet tooth cravings.

featured_reviews.name: Chef Vaidehi Pathare
featured_reviews.review_text:
After lunch, we were strolling through the lanes of Oshiwara when Ice Cream Works caught our eye. The shop is located near the Oshiwara Police Station and looked bright and inviting, so we decided to walk in. I loved the calm and minimal setup with soft colour tones and neat interiors. The place is air-conditioned, which makes it a comfortable spot to sit back and enjoy some ice cream.

The staff was kind and patient while showing us the different flavours. The counter area looked clean and organised. Since I am allergic to milk, I only tasted a bit of Chocolate to Die For, and I felt it was of good quality. My colleagues tried Pistachio and Chocolate to Die For, and they liked it too. They also have Scoops in Cones, Sundaes, Milkshakes, Casata, Ice Cream Cake, and Sizzling Brownie. The quantity was fair for the price, though it does feel slightly on the higher side.

Overall, Ice Cream Works is a pleasant place to stop by if you are around Oshiwara and in the mood for a creamy dessert.

Ratings:
Quality - 3.5/5
Quantity - 4/5
Service - 3.9/5
Price - ₹450 for 3 people

For more mouthwatering food content, do not forget to follow @chefvaidehipathare on Instagram!

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Festive Treats at Ice Cream Works – Oshiwara! ⭐
We recently visited Ice Cream Works, Oshiwara (Shop No. 23, Ground Floor, Link Plaza Commercial Complex, New Link Rd, next to Shreejee's Pure Veg Restaurant, Andheri West) — and what a delightful experience it was!
This place is already well-known for its delicious shakes, sundaes, cones, and ice cream scoops, but they've launched some special festive flavours for Diwali, and we had to try them!
We tasted:
🧡 Motichoor Ladoo Ice Cream – Rich, creamy, and perfectly captures the festive vibes.
🍫 Masala Milk Chocolate Ice Cream – A unique blend of traditional masala milk with chocolate – unexpectedly amazing!
🌹 Gulab Jamun Ice Cream – Soft gulab jamun bits in a smooth, flavorful ice cream base – absolutely divine.
🍰 Oreo Chocolate Mini Bento Cake – Perfectly moist, chocolaty, and just the right size to satisfy your sweet tooth.
They also had a fun “Spin the Wheel” festive activity for a chance to win exciting goodies – a great touch to add some celebration cheer!
Highly recommend visiting with your loved ones this Diwali season. Don't miss out on these limited-edition treats! 🎉🍨

featured_reviews.name: Srushti
featured_reviews.review_text: The ice creams are very delicious. We got Coffee almond fudge, vanilla and sizzling brownie. The best part was the hospitality. The staff was well informed, friendly and polite especially Kaushalya. 10/10 service.

featured_reviews.name: Suyash Karangutkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked in a cosy corner of Oshiwara, Ice Cream Works offers a charming little break from the city’s buzz – and if you’re a chocolate lover, their Belgium Chocolate is a must-try.

I recently visited and chose the Belgium Chocolate flavour, and it did not disappoint. Rich, indulgent, and deeply satisfying, it had the perfect balance of bittersweet notes that true chocolate lovers will appreciate. The texture was smooth and creamy, melting beautifully in every bite. You could actually taste the quality cocoa, which gave it a luxurious depth.

The parlour itself is bright, clean, and cheerful – perfect for a quick dessert stop or a casual outing. The staff were polite, helpful, and quick with service.

If you’re around Oshiwara and craving something decadent, Ice Cream Works is worth the stop – especially for their standout Belgium Chocolate!

featured_reviews.name: Abdullah Nore
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have visited multiple Baba Falooda branches over the years — Mahim, Crawford Market, and Andheri — and I always had a small request: please don’t add extra sugar syrup because my dad has diabetes and I personally prefer less sweetness. Every branch always understood and respected this request.

Recently at the Crawford Market branch, I even requested them to customize my order a little differently. Personally, I feel the regular increment-only flavours are subpar, while the kulfi-mix flavours like Green Pista and Malai Top taste much better — they’re just a bit too sweet for me. So I requested them not to add the Malai Kulfi or Pista Kulfi in those faloodas and instead make the base more ice-cream focused. The staff politely informed me that the taste would change, but I was completely fine with that, and honestly, I ended up liking it much more that way. The staff at these branches have always been polite, understanding, and delightful.

Today, however, I visited the Kurla branch of Baba Falooda, and the experience was extremely disappointing. Since it was a new branch for me, I was excited to try it and thought I would continue visiting this branch every year like the others.

Initially, the staff seemed ready to accommodate my request, but one staff member behaved very unprofessionally and refused, saying it was “more work.” That attitude was upsetting. People have different health conditions and taste preferences — some have diabetes, some prefer less sugar — and every other Baba Falooda branch has always understood this simple request except the Kurla branch.

I was extremely hungry at the time, but the rude and egoistic behavior of that staff member completely spoiled the experience for me. This review is being posted because I’m speaking about Baba Falooda as a franchise overall. After today’s experience, I genuinely do not feel like visiting any Baba Falooda branch again.

featured_reviews.name: Md. Farhan Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a dessert lover in Mumbai, Baba Falooda is an absolute must-visit! The place is famous for its rich and refreshing faloodas that perfectly balance sweetness, texture, and flavor. The falooda comes loaded with creamy kulfi, silky vermicelli, basil seeds, and generous scoops of ice cream, making every bite incredibly satisfying.
What makes Baba Falooda special is the authentic taste and generous portion size. The kulfi is dense and flavorful, and the combination with rose syrup and chilled milk creates a dessert that’s both refreshing and indulgent. Despite being extremely popular and often crowded, the service is quick and efficient.
Whether you go after dinner or just to satisfy a sweet craving, Baba Falooda never disappoints. It’s one of those iconic Mumbai dessert spots that truly lives up to the hype.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried a few flavors at Baba Falooda recently. The Mango, Malai, and Pista faloodas were all delicious—rich, flavorful, and definitely worth ordering. I'd recommend sticking to Mango, Malai, or Pista and giving the Black Currant a miss.
Overall, a great spot for a refreshing falooda fix!

featured_reviews.name: Manish Dhanavade
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐ (for Jogeshwari) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (for Mahim)

Having had an excellent experience at Baba Falooda, Mahim, I was excited to try their new branch in Jogeshwari, but unfortunately, it was quite disappointing. The experience was not even 50% of what Mahim offers.

The ice cream and kulfi quality and quantity were not up to the mark, lacking the rich, creamy texture that Baba Falooda is known for. The dry fruits were sparse, and the overall falooda felt ordinary rather than indulgent. The taste, richness, and generosity that define the Mahim outlet were clearly missing.

Mahim continues to set a very high benchmark with its creamy, rich falooda and generous toppings, but the Jogeshwari branch has a long way to go to match that standard. I genuinely hope they improve consistency across outlets, because the brand name carries strong expectations.

Recommendation:
For the true Baba Falooda experience, Mahim is still the place to go. Jogeshwari needs significant improvement in quality, quantity, and overall execution.

featured_reviews.name: M D
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this outlet of apsara ice cream, near m g road, vidya niketan marg, goregaon.

As there was 50% off on purchase of ice cream, I ordered 2 scoops. They packed the ice cream but the sales person asked for my mobile number at the time of payment.

I did not wish to give my mobile number but he insisted for my number and the said that the discount will be given only if I give my phone number otherwise I will have to buy at the regular price.

I asked him whether my mobile number is more valuable than the purchase to which he said that it is company policy.

Hence, I had no choice but to leave the outlet without buying ice cream and the sales person was ok with it.

So not only has your company lost a customer permanently, I will also never recommend apsara ice cream to anyone hereafter.

I would like to bring to your notice the following excerpt regarding consumer rights and business practice:

The Consumer Affairs Ministry has issued an advisory directing retailers not to insist on the personal contact details of consumers for delivering certain services.

The new advisory issued by the Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India, states that requiring a consumer's mobile number as a condition for the sale of a product when the consumer declines to provide it is a violation of consumer rights and an unjust business practise.

The advisory mentions Section 72 - A of the Information Technology Act, 2000 considering the act of obtaining a mobile number without consent as a punishable offence.

I hope the management of this company looks into this matter and reviews it's policies to conduct their business in an ethical manner.

P. S.: I've notified the company via email as well, so kindly don't give your standard, automated reply stating people to call on your mobile number etc.
